name: comp-103
blurb: Pill-shaped vote control with upvote and downvote buttons around a primary badge.
description: A fully-rounded grouped control with chevron buttons and a centered count badge with primary theme. Negative margins tightly group the elements.
use_when: Showing vote counts with a more rounded, modern aesthetic.
avoid_when: When you need custom vote state or when primary color conflicts with design.
a11y: Uses aria-label on buttons and aria-hidden on icons. Focus ring z-index prevents overlap.
